title: THE PAD WALK NO LONGER DRAWS THE PACKED GUNS
why: Found by the review of the four-gun belt (build 3). On a controller the bumpers walk the tactical belt. With a third and a fourth gun packed on keys 3 and 4, RB from key 2 to Smoke on key 5 drew the gun on key 3, then the gun on key 4, so he reached Smoke holding a gun he never chose, and each draw cancelled a reload; LB back reshuffled them again. This hit every pad raid with three or more guns, player 2 on a controller included. The walk now only moves the highlight onto a packed gun and names it (RT TO DRAW); the trigger draws it and fires nothing on that press, the next press fires it. Kid firing does not draw it either. A number key still draws a packed gun at once.
now: On a controller the bumpers walk past the packed guns on keys 3 and 4 without drawing them; RT draws the one you stop on.
